attractions.name: Itsukushima Shrine and Miyajima
attractions.description: Island shrine reached by ferry, with a shopping arcade.
tips: Ferry ports have accessible ramps; ferries have no special wheelchair facilities but are easy to board
Itsukushima Shrine is wheelchair accessible with ramps at the main entrance and on each step
The ropeway to the 535 m island summit is not wheelchair accessible
attractions._source_file: Japan/All Inclusive Guide- Japan- AK and families(1).docx

attractions.name: Itsukushima Shrine
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage shrine famous for its red torii gate standing offshore
tips: Check tide timings to see the torii surrounded by water or walk closer at low tide

attractions.name: Omotesando Shopping Street (Miyajima)
attractions.description: Main street with souvenir shops, food stalls and traditional sweets; try momiji manju

attractions.name: Momijidani Park
attractions.description: Park known for maple trees, especially attractive in autumn, on the way to the Mount Misen ropeway station

attractions.name: Mount Misen Ropeway
attractions.description: Ropeway with panoramic views over the Seto Inland Sea islands
tips: Operations may be affected by strong winds or bad weather
Ropeway closes before evening and last ascent is earlier than last descent; check schedule
Prioritise the ropeway over extended shopping

attractions.name: Shishiiwa Observatory
attractions.description: Viewpoint at the upper ropeway station with sweeping Seto Inland Sea views
tips: Mount Misen summit needs an extra uphill walk of about 30 minutes each way

attractions.name: Miyajima Omotesando Shopping Street
attractions.description: Lively street with street food stalls and souvenir shops, 6 minute walk from Itsukushima Shrine

local_dishes.name: Grilled Oysters
local_dishes.description: Miyajima is famous for oysters, commonly grilled or cooked

local_dishes.name: Anago-meshi
local_dishes.description: Grilled conger eel over rice, a Miyajima speciality

local_dishes.name: Momiji Manju
local_dishes.description: Maple-leaf-shaped cakes traditionally filled with sweet red bean paste; custard and other fillings also available

souvenirs.item: Itsukushima Shrine omamori charms and keepsakes

transport_options.description: JR Sanyo Line from Hiroshima Station to Miyajimaguchi (about 25–35 min), then ferry to Miyajima (about 10 min)
transport_options.how_to_use: Keep IC card or ferry ticket handy and check return ferry timings

season_notes.tip: Ropeway may be disrupted by strong winds or bad weather
